from solution import rearange_string


def test_issue_example_aab():
    """Example: rearange_string("aab") == "aba"."""
    expected = "aba"  # n=3, max=2, (3+1)//2==2 so only valid perm is "aba"
    assert rearange_string("aab") == expected


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Empty input needs no rearrangement: rearange_string("") == ""."""
    expected = ""  # len("")==0 so expected len 0+0==0
    assert rearange_string("") == expected


def test_issue_single_character():
    """Single character has no neighbour so rearange_string("a") == "a"."""
    expected = "a"  # n=1, (1+1)//2==1 so max 1<=1 possible
    assert rearange_string("a") == expected


def test_issue_two_distinct():
    """Two different letters can be rearranged with no equal neighbours."""
    result = rearange_string("ab")
    # sorted("ab")==['a','b'], len("ab")==2, need 2-1==1 check
    assert isinstance(result, str) and len(result) == 2 and sorted(result) == ["a", "b"] and result[0] != result[1]


def test_issue_possible_at_threshold():
    """Boundary possible: "aabb" with max 2 <= (4+1)//2==2 must be valid."""
    result = rearange_string("aabb")
    # sorted("aabb")==['a','a','b','b'], len==4, need 4-1==3 neighbour checks
    assert isinstance(result, str) and len(result) == 4 and sorted(result) == ["a", "a", "b", "b"] and all(result[i] != result[i + 1] for i in range(3))


def test_issue_impossible_pair():
    """Impossible input "aa" must not return a valid adjacent-different rearrangement."""
    result = rearange_string("aa")
    # n=2, max=2, (2+1)//2==1, 2>1 so impossible; sorted("aa")==['a','a']
    is_perm = isinstance(result, str) and sorted(result) == ["a", "a"]
    no_adj = isinstance(result, str) and len(result) == 2 and result[0] != result[1]
    assert not (is_perm and no_adj)


def test_issue_impossible_just_above_threshold():
    """Just above threshold "aaab" with max 3 > (4+1)//2==2 must not claim valid."""
    result = rearange_string("aaab")
    # n=4, max=3, (4+1)//2==2, 3>2 impossible; sorted("aaab")==['a','a','a','b']
    is_perm = isinstance(result, str) and sorted(result) == ["a", "a", "a", "b"]
    no_adj = isinstance(result, str) and len(result) == 4 and all(result[i] != result[i + 1] for i in range(3))
    assert not (is_perm and no_adj)


def test_contract_preserves_length():
    """Rearranged string must preserve length."""
    result = rearange_string("aabbc")
    expected_len = 5  # len("aabbc")==5
    assert len(result) == expected_len


def test_contract_preserves_characters():
    """Rearranged string must preserve character multiset."""
    result = rearange_string("aabbc")
    expected_sorted = ["a", "a", "b", "b", "c"]  # sorted("aabbc")==['a','a','b','b','c']
    assert sorted(result) == expected_sorted


def test_contract_no_equal_neighbours():
    """Rearranged possible string must have no equal adjacent characters."""
    result = rearange_string("aabbc")
    # n=5, max=2, (5+1)//2==3, 2<=3 possible; need 5-1==4 neighbour checks
    assert isinstance(result, str) and len(result) == 5 and all(result[i] != result[i + 1] for i in range(4))


def test_contract_returns_string():
    """Rearrangement result must be a string."""
    result = rearange_string("aab")
    # len("aab")==3, (3+1)//2==2 so possible
    assert isinstance(result, str)


def test_contract_input_unchanged():
    """Input string must not be mutated by the call."""
    s = "aab"  # len("aab")==3
    rearange_string(s)
    assert s == "aab"
